tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Lists open invoices for an account and returns them as a list, or an error if the account does not exist.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Searches orders by customer email and returns a list of matching orders, or an empty list if none match. Raises an error on an invalid email.

tools.name: fetch_file
tools.description: Fetches a file and returns its contents; raises an error if the path is invalid or the upload has not finished.
